title: [Bug]: non-ASCII token shifts Bash path extraction, so ACCEPT_EDITS auto-allows dangerous paths and writes outside the working directory
body:
### Background / Description

`BashCommandParser` parses the raw command as UTF-8 bytes
(`self.parser.parse(bytes(cmd, "utf8"))`), so tree-sitter reports
`Node.start_byte` / `Node.end_byte` as **byte*…
